ios.desc:
Livrin is a small collection of illustrated read-aloud books for young children. Tap the page to hear sounds, follow the words as the story is read, and switch between Portuguese, Spanish, and English whenever you like.

It's free. No ads. No sign-up. No tracking. No in-app purchases.

Each book has about twelve hand-illustrated pages, with soft narration your child can follow along with. Some books come with the app; others download once and then work offline, so the story is ready even without wifi.

What you'll find:
- Soft narration on every page
- Text that follows the voice
- Tap-for-sound zones on the illustrations
- Books organized by collection in the library
- Three languages: Portuguese, Spanish, and English
- Works offline after downloading

No purchases. No ads. No account. No data collected. Made for children ages 2 to 8.

Made by a small team that wanted stories worth keeping.

quotes.text:
SEEKING FREELANCER | Remote | Part-time

Tech: React Native / Expo

Hey, I am looking for someone who has experience implementing in-app purchases in a React Native mobile app published in both app stores (App Store and Play Store). Some native mobile development knowledge might come in handy too.

Our app is already developed and published in both stores [0][1] as a paid app. We are changing to a free app with in-app purchases. It is a simple app, with three children stories. In the freemium version it will have one free story while the two others will be paid.

I need someone with real experience that can implement this for me or even just guide me so I can develop it myself (I am a web developer, just not a mobile developer and confused by the document and process around in-app purchases).

It should a short, one-time job. I would guess less than 10 hours because my need is very specific. Thank you for considering it.

Email: rodrigo at the domain livrin.com.br.

[0] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=br.com.livrin.app
[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/livrin-livros-infantis/id1536023714
